leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic List<T> component with type parameter T
Initialize a generic list with different data types (string, number, custom object)
Render a generic list in the template using Angular's structural directives
Configure input properties to pass typed data to the generic component
Apply type safety by restricting list operations to the specified generic type
Manipulate list items through typed methods like add, remove, and filter
Integrate the generic List<T> component into a parent component with proper data binding
